description: Whole-market views, no asset needed.. view=mindshare ranks assets by share of attention over a period, with hot on those heating up. view=call_book is the crowd's long/short lean, one bar per hour plus a live tick: read crowdingPercentile rather than longShare, since the accounts lean long almost always. view=trending_contracts ranks contract addresses by how many posts pasted them, crypto only, and the unnamed ones are often the ones worth watching.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous reply. Change any argument but limit and it fails; start again without it.

from.description: view=call_book and view=trending_contracts, required. Start of the range, unix seconds, not milliseconds. Trending contracts read 30 days at most.

limit.description: Items per page, up to 200. Keep it small and page with cursor rather than asking for everything at once.

market.description: crypto or equity. trending_contracts is crypto only.

minMentions.description: view=trending_contracts. Leave out addresses pasted fewer times. Default 5.

period.description: view=mindshare. The stretch share covers, ending at to. Default 4h.

to.description: End of the range, unix seconds. Defaults to now.

name: market
title: Market
